about: The other side talks with music playing in the background.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Can you hear me? I think you have some music on in the background.

truth.speaker: Cori
truth.text: Sorry, that's the radio in the kitchen. I can't turn it off right now, is it very loud?

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: It's fine, I can understand you. Let's keep it short then.

truth.speaker: Cori
truth.text: Sure. The main thing is the new laptop. Omarchy installed in under a minute, but the fingerprint reader doesn't work yet.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Okay, I'll ask the hardware team today. They fixed the same reader on the other model last week.

truth.speaker: Cori
truth.text: Perfect. And could you send me the link to the manual page about it?

truth.speaker: Cori
truth.text: No, that was it. Thanks, and sorry again about the radio.
